cardEffects:
＜Barrier＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted in battle, by trashing the top card of your security stack, prevent that deletion.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] By trashing the top card of your security stack, change the original DP of 1 Digimon to 6000 until the end of your opponent's turn.
inheritedEffect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When a card is removed from your security stack, unsuspend this Digimon.
name: Mistymon

rulings.answer: Such effects change the original DP shown on the target card to the predetermined value shown in the effect.  For example, if a Digimon has an original DP of 8000 and it's chosen as the target for a "[Main] Change the original DP of 1 of your opponent's Digimon to 3000 until the end of their turn" effect, that Digimon's original DP will become 3000 instead of 8000.
rulings.question: What does the "change 1 Digimon's original DP" effect do, exactly?

rulings.answer: Its original DP is changed, then +1000 is added to the changed DP.  Values added to DP don't affect the original DP.
rulings.question: What happens if a Digimon that got +1000 DP has its original DP changed by the "change 1 Digimon's original DP" effect?

rulings.answer: The original DP is changed to the most recent value.
rulings.question: What happens if a Digimon has its original DP changed and is then affected by a "change 1 Digimon's original DP" effect again?

rulings.answer: No, it can't.  Effects that change information can't change information that a card didn't originally have.  For example, if a Digimon has its original DP changed by an effect and then its top card becomes a card without DP due to a ＜De-Digivolve＞ effect, it will no longer be affected by the effect that changes the original DP.
